title: Welcome module
hero.title: Welcome to NovaNuke
hero.description: A lightweight modular content management system built for people who want to create and control their own websites.
story.modern: NovaNuke is written from scratch for modern PHP, uses server-side rendering, and is designed to run on environments ranging from a local Laragon installation to traditional shared hosting.
story.roots: NovaNuke is also a project with old-school roots. Long before every website became a service, a subscription or a JavaScript application, webmasters could download a CMS, install it on their own server, choose a theme, activate a few modules and begin building. Projects such as PHP-Nuke helped make that experience accessible to an entire generation of site owners.
story.spirit: NovaNuke takes inspiration from that independent and modular spirit while building its own modern foundation.
feature.core.title: A small core with room to grow
feature.core.text: A small website might only need Pages, News and Search. A private website can add accounts, memberships and restricted content. Larger projects can bring in Downloads, Wiki, Comments, Web Links, Polls, Private Messages and more.
feature.web.title: Built for the independent web
feature.web.text: Your website, content and database remain under your control. NovaNuke is designed with ordinary PHP and MySQL or MariaDB hosting in mind—not only complex deployment platforms.
feature.pieces.title: Pieces you can combine
feature.pieces.text: Themes control presentation while modules and blocks extend the site around its content. The goal is not to force every website into the same shape.
capabilities.title: More than a publishing screen
capabilities.description: NovaNuke already brings together publishing, community and site-management tools in one modular system.
capabilities.operations: Backups, migrations and CLI system checks
status.title: Still under development
status.text: NovaNuke is approaching its first stable release. The project already contains a substantial working system, while release-candidate testing, production verification and documentation continue. Features will not be presented as finished merely because they appear on a roadmap.
explore.title: What you will find here
explore.description: This site is the home for release announcements, guides, developer documentation, practical tutorials, troubleshooting notes, project history and development discussions.
closing.lead: The objective is not simply to place another ZIP file on the internet.
closing.title: Discover it. Install it. Build something useful.
